steps.en: Install it into your agent as a skill
steps.zh: 把它作为技能装进你的智能体

steps.en: Point it at a book, a folder or a glob
steps.zh: 指向一本书、一个目录或一个通配路径

steps.en: Asks technical or text-heavy, then extracts clean text with the matching tool
steps.zh: 先问是技术书还是文字书，再用对应工具提取干净文本

steps.en: Has your agent's model write SKILL.md plus one file per chapter, glossary and cheatsheet
steps.zh: 让你的智能体模型写出 SKILL.md、每章一个文件、术语表和速查表

steps.en: Later, ask the new skill about a topic
steps.zh: 之后按主题向这个新技能提问

steps.en: Loads only the matching chapter and answers from its notes
steps.zh: 只加载对应的那一章，依据其中的笔记作答

value.en: The book is on tap in every session for a few thousand tokens instead of the whole text
value.zh: 每个会话只花几千 token 就能随时调用这本书，而不是整本塞进上下文

sources: https://github.com/virgiliojr94/book-to-skill README (How it works in 3 steps: /book-to-skill ./my-book.pdf, /my-book replication; What it generates; Install: npx skills add virgiliojr94/book-to-skill)
https://github.com/virgiliojr94/book-to-skill/blob/master/docs/how-it-works.md (technical vs text-heavy choice, extractor then agent-generated SKILL.md, chapter files, glossary, patterns, cheatsheet)
